title: reader's SmtpRelayQueue always passes None for dkim_signer — relay path never signs
description: crates/reader/src/store/server_stores.rs:385 constructs SmtpRelayQueue with hardcoded None for dkim_signer. The reader crate has no DKIM config and no mechanism to wire a signer. Consequence: any message posted via the reader's NNTP POST path and relayed via SmtpRelayQueue (relay_queue.rs:try_deliver_one) is sent unsigned, regardless of what the smtp binary's delivery.dkim config says. The two binaries share SmtpRelayQueue but the reader has no DKIM key wiring. This is a silent gap: no warning is logged, no config error is raised.
